meta.quote_basis: Live availability quotes returned by guide.michelin.com hotel pages for 2 adults, 1 room, check-in 2027-02-15, check-out 2027-02-22 (7 nights). Michelin displays an average nightly rate and a 7-night total including taxes & fees. Both numbers below are copied exactly as displayed.
meta.room_requirement_check: Queen bed or larger + private bathroom. Only room types satisfying that are quoted.
meta.important_caveat: These are same-day quotes for a stay 15 months out. Hotel inventory for Feb 2027 is thin this far ahead; re-quote before booking. A 'MEMBER RATE' flag means the Michelin Plus member rate — the standard rate may be higher.

seasonality_check.hotel: Arlo Soho, Queen Courtyard View (identical room type, free-cancellation rate)
seasonality_check.method: Four separate 7-night availability queries against the same room type on the same day.
seasonality_check.finding: Within the Feb 15 – Mar 23 2027 window, the earliest 7-night stay tested (Feb 15–22) is the cheapest, and mid-March is ~59% more expensive for the identical room. Your preferred window is, on this evidence, also the cheapest one.
